lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance blobs arranged in three distinct horizontal rows across the mid-flank. A central cluster of four primary spots posterior to the gill slits forms a trapezoidal 2D spatial arrangement.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting the horizontal rows of spots, creating a discernible grid-like pattern across the mid-lateral region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent longitudinal ridges running horizontally along the upper third of the flank; the uppermost ridge exhibits a sharp vertical intensity gradient transition from high-luminance on the dorsal side to shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution consisting of approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs clustered primarily along the anterior margin and the basal region of the first dorsal fin's silhouette.
